description: The Massachusetts Legislature enacted a $56.2 billion budget for Fiscal Year 2024 (FY24). The FY24 budget sent to Governor Healey provides for historic levels of investment in education, housing, regional transportation, health care, workforce development, and more, as part of a broad strategy to grow our state’s economy and make Massachusetts more affordable, inclusive, and competitive. Click below to read the full press release: Representative Gordon – FY 24 Budget Press Release
